name: Morpho Lodging: Inns
description: Independent inns in the US (not Maine) with roughly 10 to 40 rooms, frequently with a restaurant, bar, weddings or events on site. Owner-operators or couples running the property, family-owned historic inns, or inns recently acquired by investors who see value in the building and location. The owner makes the decisions and is reachable. Operating, or opening within six months with funding. Does NOT qualify: inns that are part of a hotel brand or soft brand, properties run by a third-party management company the owner cannot hire around, bed and breakfasts under 10 rooms with no meaningful food or event revenue (those belong to the B&B ICP), hotels over 40 rooms (boutique hotel ICP), restaurants or wedding venues with no lodging, retirement or assisted living 'inns', and chain 'inn' branded motels (Holiday Inn, Hampton Inn, Comfort Inn, Days Inn, Quality Inn, Red Roof Inn, La Quinta Inn, Residence Inn, Fairfield Inn). Room count must be verified from the website (a stated number or a rooms listing).
offer_context: Morpho sells a fractional operations retainer: documented systems so new hires stop learning by shadowing, event sales and booking process, kitchen and front-of-house staffing structure, visibility into which of lodging, food and events actually makes money, and the owner out of daily decisions. Buying signals: chef or manager departure, kitchen or housekeeping job posts, adding or dropping events, change of ownership, owner planning to sell, a soft wedding season, an inquiry form instead of real-time booking, owner names on every review reply.

options.owner_operator: innkeeper-owner or couple running the inn themselves, often living on site, often also running the kitchen or events
options.portfolio_owner_manager: owns or manages two or more inns, or an inn plus other lodging, with a manager or innkeeper at each
options.recent_acquirer: bought the inn in the last 24 months ('new innkeepers', 'under new ownership', 'we purchased the inn in 2025'), often an investor or first-time hospitality owner

options.independent_inn: independently owned inn with 10 to 40 guest rooms, lodging is the core business
options.inn_with_restaurant_or_events: independent inn that also runs a restaurant, tavern, weddings or events on site
options.bed_and_breakfast_small: under 10 rooms, breakfast included, owner-hosted, no significant food or event revenue (B&B ICP)
options.boutique_hotel_large: over 40 rooms or clearly a hotel rather than an inn (boutique hotel ICP)
options.branded_or_chain_inn: Holiday Inn, Hampton Inn, Comfort Inn, Quality Inn, Days Inn, Red Roof Inn, La Quinta, Residence Inn, Fairfield Inn or any brand
options.third_party_managed: operated by a hotel or inn management company on behalf of the owner
options.restaurant_or_venue_only: restaurant, tavern or wedding venue with no overnight rooms
options.senior_living_or_other_inn: assisted living, retirement community, rehab or anything else called an inn that is not lodging
options.vacation_rental_company: manages rental homes rather than running an inn
options.pre_opening_or_concept: announced, under restoration or for sale with no operating rooms
